game_concept: A action defense set in Mystic Forest – Canopy Walkway, rope walkways in the canopy: the fairy gardener must handle bramble beasts while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Stride Selector: Use range(start, stop, step) to hit only the right stepping stones.
theme: Mystic Forest – Canopy Walkway: rope walkways in the canopy
core_gameplay_loop: In Canopy Walkway, repeat each round: Use range(start, stop, step) to hit only the right stepping stones. Each round, bramble beasts strike the vine bridge, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the stones value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the vine bridge from bramble beasts in Canopy Walkway: keep the stones meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 42-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: stones drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 42-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 5 (applied tier): Stride Selector
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Stride Selector' (Week 5 slot 3), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Canopy Walkway'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how stones changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against bramble beasts in Canopy Walkway.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 42 seconds while stones > 0.
